checks.detail: Institutional authority must validate without source-truth conflicts.
Knowledge cards=18; hybrid/authority metadata required.
EONBOT must add a turn-relevant reviewed capability overlay, and current Creator execution truth must be separated from historical Workspace draft truth.
EONBOT first-turn truth must describe reviewed hosted fal/Replicate Image/Video rails without upgrading source integration into live provider certification or authorizing reference-media upload.
EONBOT grounding must route referral/EONKEY questions to server-authoritative truth and never infer value from sharing.
Static Chat grounding must not contradict a deployment whose /api/referrals rollout is active.
Server EONKEY referral authority must be distinct from the historical blocked wallet/token/payout/commercial-referral rail.
Referral/EONKEY questions must reach the server-authoritative status surface while payout/cash/crypto requests remain blocked.
Memory must be scoped/editable/exportable and must not imply fine-tuning/raw-chat capture.
Saved memory may personalize grounding but must remain untrusted data that cannot grant action authority or override system/product truth.
Fetched or pasted research text must remain untrusted evidence data and cannot become instructions, tool permission or private-context authority.
Chat must expose a simple Off / Ask / Safe Auto memory control plus a visible path to the full local memory manager.
The full memory manager must support explicit local export without claiming credentials or raw Chat history are included.
Safe-auto is allowed only for structured product signals.
Safe Auto may learn only finite explicit model/runtime/language/radio controls; raw chat and free-text station prompts must never enter this bridge.

Browser-direct AI batch and streaming responses must be byte/buffer/output bounded before parsing/rendering; provider error text must be redacted and bounded; no response persistence or hidden fallback.
Batch and streaming Chat must enforce the same concurrency/rate guard and count the foreground attempt before transport, so failed requests cannot evade the local runaway/cost-storm limit.
Routing must fail closed around provider, cost and install boundaries.
Evaluation ledger may store bounded metrics, never prompt/response/error-text/credential/provider payloads.
Real user-initiated AI requests may teach local reliability/latency evidence, but operational success must never be converted into answer-quality evidence or content capture.
Explicit thumbs feedback may teach task-scoped model quality, but it must reuse bounded provider/model/task/request metadata and never copy the prompt or reply into the learning ledger.
Adaptive model performance learning must have a visible local reset that does not delete Chat, Memory, credentials or installed models.
Provider verification must retain a finite policy/task-diverse model envelope rather than making the provider response first-12 order authoritative.
Verified model intelligence may use source-reported context/capability metadata but must not invent pricing/capabilities or persist arbitrary provider prose.
LM Studio may use its native v1 model manifest for bounded capability metadata while inference remains on the reviewed OpenAI-compatible route.

Local model lifecycle must be scan-explicit, freshness-aware and fail unknown; notices may recommend reviewed installed/install candidates but cannot download, install or select a Chat model automatically.

Beginner private-chat guidance and reviewed catalogue must agree on the first model, arbitrary first scan results must not auto-fill, and active setup copy must not call current media adapters future work.
Local model upgrades may offer an explicit Ollama command or official runtime manager handoff, but EONAPP must not map tags across runtimes or start a download.

Provider-reported context windows must cap output, user input, total history and grounding density; reported windows below the institutional minimum must fail closed instead of silently overflowing or switching models.
Creator must expose Image, Video and Music as the first three modes.
EONBOT Image/Video/Music intents must prepare canonical Creator routes behind an explicit user-tap boundary and never claim generation completion.
Chat → Image/Video/Music prompt continuity must be user-tapped, WeakMap-associated before navigation, session-only, one-time, absent from URLs/receipts/telemetry, and never start generation.
Share/remix intent and action-plan review state must survive the live turn via WeakMaps without becoming serialized conversation fields.
Music planning/pattern features must not overclaim generative render or commercial catalogue access.
ACE-Step may be source-integrated but must remain explicit, no-download/no-training/no-reference-audio and external-proof-pending.
Hosted Music must be a reviewed prompt-only Direct BYOK rail with no upload/inpainting/auto-retry/fake-cancel/EONAPP proxy claim and real-provider proof still pending.
The hosted Music rail must use one finite reviewed Music v2 model id rather than arbitrary provider model selection.

Hosted provider credentials must move only through a paired loopback request into the OS vault; generated binary stays bounded/expiring in companion memory and browser preflight must support the reviewed authenticated loopback contract.

Creator Companion pairing, job status/cancel and temporary outputs must be bound to the exact paired session, use the canonical origin allowlist, reject job-id collisions and retain no raw prompt in the job map.
Creator Companion must enforce a local per-session outstanding-job ceiling and short submission-rate window even if UI controls are bypassed; provider-acknowledged cancellation must become terminal.
Provider JSON/media reads must be stream-bounded and public failure messages must be fixed/sanitized rather than echoing raw upstream text.
Loopback pairing-code creation must be origin-allowlisted and locally throttled so an approved-origin page cannot flood the companion terminal with challenges.
ComfyUI view proxy must accept ordinary reviewed output names but reject traversal, nested filename paths and unreviewed output types before any loopback fetch.
Canonical EON Music must expose explicit provider-cost review, paired OS-vault credential setup and local output retrieval without automatic retry.
Direct BYOK launch certification must require real hosted-Music output, OS-vault custody and binary-memory-expiry evidence.
Auto DJ may metadata-sequence and locally crossfade user-authorized/EON-generated audio, but it must not claim beat matching, time stretch, stems, upload or rendered mix export.
Browser, ACE-Step and hosted Music must earn progression only after explicit save + byte-for-byte reopened audio verification; proof must not store prompts, credentials or upload audio.
The shared Music/Radio engine must preserve truthful /eoncity receipt provenance when used inside City, without creating a City-only media fork.
EON-generated browser, local ACE-Step and hosted BYOK tracks must be able to enter the session-only Auto DJ preview without re-uploading to EONAPP.
Persisted private EON Radio station profiles must have an explicit delete control on the canonical Music surface.
Current local ComfyUI adapter must not claim music until a real audio workflow is implemented/certified.
Creator registry must expose ACE-Step as source-integrated/proof-pending with optional credentials kept session-only.
Music must live on canonical Create, not resurrect the retired route.
Canonical Music must expose explicit ACE-Step scan/generate controls without model initialization or download actions.
ACE-Step loopback access must be available to both canonical Create and EONCITY through the least-privilege shared CSP.
The paired Creator Companion must be reachable from both canonical Create and EONCITY, without adding a LAN wildcard or arbitrary loopback port.
Bridge must admit only reviewed ACE-Step generation/status/output paths and reject init/training/arbitrary local file reads.
Legacy /music-studio route must stay retired/redirected.
Canonical model request runtime must not import the compatibility auto-router.

Canonical createAIReply must re-rank only the current verified same-provider candidate envelope for each request, honor explicit model pins, classify the current task ephemerally, and fail Private mode closed to device-local AI.
Provider verification may populate a verified candidate list but must not silently convert its winner into a permanent pin; only the explicit Model control may create a model pin.
Hosted model catalogues must be refreshable from the selected provider on explicit user action, reusing the current policy without downloading models or changing provider authority.
Active Local AI and master ledger must describe source-integrated video with external proof pending.
Deterministic browser pattern generation must not be labelled as model-generated audio.
Hosted Image/Video may expose only explicitly reviewed prompt-first source rails, while their registry must continue to mark real user-owned provider proof pending.
Hosted Image/Video must keep provider keys and provider output URLs behind the paired Companion, return only kind-checked binary media, and require a separate explicit budget-approved job.
Hosted media quality controls must be finite reviewed provider fields; image safety checking stays enabled and unknown values may not pass through as arbitrary provider input.

The fal rail must disable documented provider-side retries/fallbacks, opt out of JSON payload retention, and request short generated-media retention so one approved paid job stays one reviewed model execution with bounded provider persistence.

Hosted Image/Video must emit source-specific redacted Core receipts only after explicit save + byte-matching reopen; hosted Video also requires reopened playback completion, and provider provenance must be pinned at generation.
Hosted media lifecycle must expose provider progress, acknowledge cancellation honestly, prove save/reopen locally, and keep reference uploads disabled.
Shared Image/Video engines must preserve truthful /eoncity receipt provenance when run inside City and lock mutable provider/artifact controls during an in-flight hosted job.

Canonical /create must reuse the maintained ComfyUI Image and Video execution labs directly, keep the advanced lane explicit/collapsed, and load their maintained styles without auto-scanning or auto-generating.
EON Radio session must remain local/session-only without commercial catalogue access.
EON Radio may continuously advance its private queue only after an explicit open-page playback action; it must not claim closed-tab/service-worker streaming or upload audio.
EON Radio may reuse only finite consent-approved preference tags; station prompts/media cannot become personalization input or action permission.
EON Radio may plan and prefill the next original track, but it must never call a provider, start local compute, spend credits or generate continuously without a separate explicit Generate action.

Image/Video/Music results must support a session-only Prepare variation loop without reading source media, persisting prompts, granting budget authority or submitting compute; Video must not overclaim media extension.

EONBOT may receive recent verified local activity only on continuation/recent-result intent, through a fixed redacted projection that excludes receipts, provider sources, prompts/media/keys and sensitive access/provider-verification outcomes, and never grants action authority.

EONCITY Quick Voice Conversation must require the shared session-bounded reviewed consent on every automatic microphone turn; both maintained City chat surfaces must share the canonical voice-language preference and reply language, while work-surface Dictate remains editable-first and never auto-sends.

EONCITY must reuse maintained Chat plus real local/hosted Image/Video and full Music execution modules instead of City-only or proposal-only AI forks; prepared creation prompts stay transient and user-tap gated.
City missions must consume redacted verified creator receipts for Image/Video/Music without private media content.

All ten W752 missions must have a real native receipt path. Unclaimable: none. Command requires explicit wall review + record; Realm requires explicit form save; Plans requires explicit server-verified access review and checkout/payment must never create mission proof.
Create Forge mission must expose explicit Image/Video/Music-Radio lanes that only switch the maintained in-City Creator and never create generation/provider/progression effects.
Productive RPG creator mission must admit verified Local and reviewed Direct BYOK Image/Video saves while rejecting route-open/prompt/preview-only progress.
Browser WAV, ACE-Step and hosted BYOK Music saves must each have an explicit Core native authority and be admitted by the same City creator-mission source policy.
City XP/progression reads must rejoin each receipt to a current policy-approved Core outcome and prune forged or orphaned progress instead of trusting browser-local progress state.
W752 must revalidate the exact native receipt and station at XP claim time; only the separate bounded EONBOT orientation proof may bypass Core-outcome projection.

Known EONBOT tool intents must stay inside maintained EONCITY stations, preserving explicit Image/Video/Music mode; unknown routes remain reviewed external handoffs and no route preparation executes providers automatically.

Create Forge mission lane buttons must prefer the maintained embedded mode switch and use the Work Surface open fallback only after an explicit user tap; opening a lane must never mint XP or start generation.
Device alerts may be source-ready but must keep live background delivery proof pending.
Activity category switches and client device quiet hours must affect delivery/storage behavior rather than remain cosmetic preferences.
Background service-alert clicks must accept only finite public same-origin EONAPP routes, with route/url compatibility but no arbitrary text/API navigation.

Explicit device-alert enable/refresh must replace stale VAPID-key subscriptions, and disable must be able to revoke server state from the current browser endpoint even when the local receipt ID is missing.
Web Push must enforce a server-authoritative 1-to-5 device cap and rate-limit explicit self-tests after failed as well as successful attempts.
Scheduled return reminders must atomically lease due rows to prevent overlapping duplicate sends while remaining bounded service alerts with no marketing/custom-message load.
Retention delivery must use minute-level D1 leasing into Cloudflare Queues with bounded batches and a D1-safe 10-consumer ceiling instead of the former 50-per-15-minute direct cron fan-out.

Retention fan-out must cap per-invocation concurrency, avoid per-success D1 heartbeat writes, retire superseded broad indexes, and delete new terminal reminders immediately while retaining indexed bounded cleanup only for legacy terminal reminder/subscription rows.
City Fair Play must distinguish opt-in Web Push source readiness from automatic outbound delivery and keep live delivery proof false until Codex verifies a real device.
Retention worker must be schedule-only with no public fetch surface.
Retention push worker must remain deployment-disabled until live proof and secrets are configured.
Disabled or unconfigured retention worker must return before querying/updating D1 or attempting delivery.
Retention worker must expose an explicit Preview D1 environment separate from Production so live push proof cannot require production data.
A real Activity item may offer one explicit route-scoped return reminder; the server must atomically replace any existing pending reminder and enforce one active reminder per account.
Music/audio must be supported by the same explicit local Share Pack/native-share path as Image and Video.
Image/Video/Music/DJ/Radio remix starters must preserve their kind without creating tracking, referral or external-remix proof.

Remix Cards must offer a privacy-preserving recipient creation loop using public-safe URL-fragment data only; opening a shared link must not create server state, tracking, referral proof, memory, provider calls or automatic generation.
Remix sharing must offer one explicit copy containing useful public-safe context plus the canonical fragment-based EONAPP remix link without adding tracking or referral proof.
Verified Creator outcomes must feed a fixed redacted local Activity Center return loop without history replay or automatic reminders.
